assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder terrain material, square native image. Near-overhead orthographic view, no horizon or vanishing point. Tactile restrained game art with shallow relief and quiet natural colors matching fine sediment and mineral seabed materials. Create an edge-to-edge shell-hash shoal ground: cool grey-beige fine sand with irregular sparse bands of tiny worn ivory shell chips and rounded charcoal grit, shallow broad broken current ripples. Mostly quiet open sediment; shell fragments small and embedded, not piles or large intact shells. Unequal ripple lengths, subtle contrast, no central focal object, no border or vignette, no plants, wreckage, text, bubbles, caustics or blue underwater wash. Opaque ground fills the whole square. Intended for repeated world-space terrain beneath station rooms; avoid conspicuous repeated motifs. No claim of exact seamless edges.
